Ferrow Energy builds and runs solar arrays owned by the communities they sit in.

Join a scheme

How our arrays performed

Each array is metered independently and the readings are published every quarter. Members can see their own scheme's output in the member area, and the underlying meter readings are available on request to anyone who asks for them.

We build only where a community group has already formed, because a scheme that nobody locally wants to run will not survive its first maintenance winter.

Ferrow Energy, Trelan Farm, Cornwall.
